book.name: 1 John
book.title: 1 JOHN JOHN AN FEF AINAUIN IGAYAM

content: Keriso On Ot ati Baibaisotin
Yau nanatu, atonio fef agagayam omi aurim onai omi men wonbokomas mes; baise iyai iyafan inbobokomas on, ot on Iesu Keriso an yawas totorin wat on tabo, On Taman bisinai nan ot aurit ebikakafun.
Ato Keriso Toun on bobo ifour ati bokomas on sinotbur, ato men ot ati bokomas wat baise sabu engon tutufin mat asi bokomas sinotbur.
Ot God an baifafaro dura tanbigibubunuai on, ot tabi dura bag On tasagobai.
Iyai iyafan inau, “Yau On asagobai” ato on an baifafaro dura aurin men inbifonabo on, on orot jever on baisigo’otin a on aurin dura maiauin on men yen.
Baise iyai iyafan On an dura aurin ebifonabo, on orot jever an nuabo God aurin on iyamai matafin imatar. On bobo nanaba on tani dura bag ot on God amonai tanama:
Iyai iyafan inau on God amonai emama, on toun an yawas on iniyamai Iesu Keriso ifofour ba on nanaba inama.
Baifafaro Dura Boboun

Yau tuturau au nuabo, atonio baifafaro dura omi aurim agagayam on men dura boboun on; atonio baifafaro dura on atamanin, omi ainau anai bag wobo. Baifafaro dura atamanin an dura on omi ainau wotatam nono.
Baise baifafaro dura omi aurim agagayam on boboun ato dura maiauin on Keriso woit a Keriso mat on omi amomui emama. Wouman on enan insawar ato ratafin maiau on ekudidir nono.
Iyai iyafan ebikakafun yau, on ratafinai emama baise on tain tuan ebisisiweiai, on ari werai bag on woumanai emama.
Iyai iyafan tain tuan ebinuaboai on ratafinai emama, ato men aifan tani on emon on turan iniyamai inbokomas.
Baise iyai iyafan tain tuan ebisisiweiai on woumanai emama; on woumanai ebibib a on men isagob on menan nan enan yabin wouman on iyamai matan ifot.
Yau nanatu, yau fef agagayam omi aurim, yabin Keriso Wabin fasinai on omi ami bokomas sinotbur.
Bab nas, yau fef agagayam omi aurim yabin On anai bag imama ato omi On wosagobai. Omi jorig boboum, yau fef agagayam omi aurim yabin omi on Afaguban wobomerubai nono.

Yau nanatu, yau fef agagayam omi aurim yabin omi Tamat wosagobai on mes. Yau tatamau, yau fef agagayam omi aurim yabin On anai bag imama ato omi On wosagobai. Omi jorig boboum, yau fef agagayam omi aurim yabin omi on faiwarim; God an dura on omi amomui emama ato omi on Afaguban wobomerubai nono.
Omi on men tafanam woninuaboai mes o sawar aifan tani tafanam ebinoanai on. Omi tafanam wonbinuaboai on, omi amomui nuabo on men Tamat aurin yen on.

Bobo engon tutufin tafanam ebinoanai on—sawar tagogoien tout ati gogoi auris on, sabu sawar seiten ato segogoien a bobo engon tutufin nin sen on sabu on sawar auris on setaseseir—atonio osi bobo on men Tamat emon senat on; osi bobo engon on tafanam emon senat.
Bobo engon tutufin tafanam amonai sen menan sabu asi gogoi osi sawar auris on enan inarab insawar; baise iyai iyafan God an gogoi efofour on wantoan inama.
Keriso An Ragit

Yau nanatu, tafanam an kanfoun on inat iufin nono! Omi dura siyawurem nono on Keriso an Ragit on arimon innat; ato ari on Keriso an Ragit sigaraba on sirobotet nono, ato on mes tasagob tafanam an kanfoun on inat iufin nono.

Atonio osi sabu on men ot ati kuayo ebinoanai, on mes ot sikiriret sigat; osi ot ati kuayo itbinoanis mes on osi nana bisiti sitama. Baise osi sinai ot aurit itrubunag tiwag osi on men iyafan tani ot ati kuayo ebinoanai on.
Baise Keriso emon on omi Ayu Kakafotin on tefamui idebur wobo amomui emama, ato omi engon on dura maiauin wosagob.
Yau fef agagayam omi aurim, on men ato dura maiauin men wosagob aurin on; baise yabin omi on wosagob a mat omi wosagob dura maiauin emon on men baisigo dura tani On emon enat on.
Iyafan on baisigogo’otin i? On iyafan dura ebikakafun yau, Iesu on men Keriso. On orot jever nanaba on Keriso an Ragit—on orot jever min Tamat a Natun rus on ebisisiweiis.
Yabin iyai iyafan Natun ebisisiweiai on Taman mat ebisisiweiai; iyai iyafan Natun eboai on, Taman mat eboai.
Omi on wonidura bag ato anai bag dura sikurereb wo’tatam on nunuamui nana wonbokikinen. Omi anai bag dura wotatam ato nana wonbokikin on, omi ra fufur Natun a Taman mat wonbikaita.
Atonio dura on Keriso Toun on ot aurit iyaumatanit yawas mama wantoanin—on initet.
Yau atonio fef agagayam omi aurim on, ato osi sabu iyabon sefofourtobon sinisigoem mes auris.

Baise omi aurim on Keriso an Ayu on omi tefamui idebur. On an Ayu bisimui emama on men iyafan tani omi inibebeyim mes. Yabin On an Ayu on bobo engon tutufin auris ebibebeyim ato aifan ebibebeyim on dura bag men baisigo mes. Ayu an baibebe on aurin wonifonabo, ato omi nana Kerisoai wonmama.
Yau nanatu, dura bag On bisinai nana wonama, onai ot on fofonit tantawar ato On inrorobotet an rai on ot arimon men On aurin mamai inboet tanob mes on an Ra inboai innanat nan.
Omi wosagob Keriso an yawas totorin wat; omi on wonsagob iyai iyafan bobo obis wat efofour on God Natun.
